to add their name to the prayer list before friday 30/10/2026. to mark the closure of kilkenny ns we will gather for a special night, on sunday 25th october, to remember with gratitude all the pupils, teachers, principals, staff, board of management, parents and parishioners who have been part of its long and proud history. mass in st connells church at 5pm will be followed by refreshments in the highlands hotel at 6pm. kilkenny ns at the heart of our parish and community since 1889. patrick macgill festival, glenties 23-25 october dedicated to revitalising and honouring his life as a writer and to ensure his work remains accessible to new generations, the patrick macgill festival, held in conjunction with st connell’s museum, glenties, will feature a rich and varied weekend of events, friday evening (23 october) will feature a screening at the highlands hotel of child of the dead end , a 2009 drama documentary about macgill, starring stephen rea which will be introduced by the director, desmond bell. saturday (24 october) will begin with a guided walk through the historic landscape of glenties, followed by two talks at the highlands hotel exploring patrick macgill’s extraordinary life and times by macgill scholar josé manuel pulido and donegal writer frank galligan. on saturday evening, a gala concert at the highlands hotel, featuring a host of local musicians and performers, will provide an unforgettable night of music, drama and poetry, inspired by macgill's poems and novels. the festival also features a poetry and short story competition for local national schools and the glenties comprehensive. tickets for the screening, heritage trail, lectures and saturday evening’s gala concert can be purchased at ticket source:
